label: Repone almacenes, correlativos y familias
summary: Inserta almacenes iniciales, series de correlativos y familias (prefijos CON, HER, ...) que falten

execute.sql: INSERT INTO "public"."almacen" (codigo, nombre) VALUES ('ALM-GENERAL','Almacén General'),('ALM-GEN1','General 1'),('ALM-GEN2','General 2'),('ALM-TAMBO','Tambo'),('ALM-ARUMA','Aruma'),('ALM-MASS','Mass'),('ALM-VALIDAR','Por validar') ON CONFLICT (codigo) DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO "public"."almacen_correlativo" (serie, ultimo) VALUES ('ING',0),('SAL',0),('TRF',0),('PRE',0) ON CONFLICT (serie) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO "public"."familia_almacen" (prefijo, nombre) VALUES ('CON','CONSUMIBLES'),('HER','HERRAMIENTAS'),('EPP','EPPS'),('TAM','TAMBO'),('ARU','ARUMA'),('MAS','MASS'),('FER','FERRETERIA'),('ELE','HERRAMIENTAS ELECTRICAS'),('EQU','EQUIPOS VARIOS') ON CONFLICT (prefijo) DO NOTHING

postcheck.description: los 7 almacenes, las 4 series y las 9 familias existen
postcheck.sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."almacen" WHERE codigo IN ('ALM-GENERAL','ALM-GEN1','ALM-GEN2','ALM-TAMBO','ALM-ARUMA','ALM-MASS','ALM-VALIDAR')) = 7 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."almacen_correlativo" WHERE serie IN ('ING','SAL','TRF','PRE')) = 4 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM "public"."familia_almacen" WHERE prefijo IN ('CON','HER','EPP','TAM','ARU','MAS','FER','ELE','EQU')) = 9 AS "result"
